title: Core Octet #25
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, eight women in a single row.

A photograph of EIGHT women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 8 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[age-gyaru / USSBBW]: Japanese woman, mid 30s, cheerful, luminous glossy skin with a bright highlighter, thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips, a confident sparkling expression, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in countless fine micro braids, oval nails (glittery). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip. Shoes: extreme gold ballet heels.
